title: First-Line Supervisors of Passenger Attendants
description: Supervise and coordinate activities of passenger attendants.

clusters.label: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Explain and demonstrate work tasks to new workers or assign training tasks to experienced workers.
Inform workers about interests or special needs of specific groups.
Train workers in proper operational procedures and functions and explain company policies.

clusters.label: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Apply customer feedback to service improvement efforts.
Resolve customer complaints regarding worker performance or services rendered.
Direct or coordinate the activities of workers, such as flight or car attendants.
Inspect materials, stock, vehicles, equipment, or facilities to ensure that they are safe, free of defects, and consistent with specifications.
Inspect work areas or operating equipment to ensure conformance to established standards in areas such as cleanliness or maintenance.
Meet with managers or other supervisors to stay informed of changes affecting operations.
Participate in continuing education to stay abreast of industry trends and developments.

clusters.label: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Observe and evaluate workers' appearance and performance to ensure quality service and compliance with specifications.
Take disciplinary action to address performance problems.
Analyze and record personnel or operational data and write related activity reports.
Compute or estimate cash, payroll, transportation, or personnel requirements.
Confer with customers, supervisors, contractors, or other personnel to exchange information or to resolve problems.
Recommend and implement measures to improve worker motivation, work methods, or customer services.
Requisition necessary supplies, equipment, or services.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Office suite software
skills.def: Software to provide word processing, spreadsheet, e-mail, presentations, or data management capabilities. Examples: Microsoft Office software.

skills.name: Electronic mail software
skills.def: Software to compose, send, or receive email. Examples: Microsoft Outlook.

skills.name: Presentation software
skills.def: Software to create presentations, speeches, or slideshows. Examples: Microsoft PowerPoint.

skills.name: Data base user interface and query software
skills.def: Software to query, present, or edit information stored in a database sytem. Examples: Microsoft Access.

skills.name: Word processing software
skills.def: Software to create, edit, store, or print documents. Examples: Microsoft Word.
